_comment: Citations and external identifiers that the published documents refer to.
This file exists so that a number appearing in a document -- an upstream
issue number, a spec version -- has a committed source like every other
number. Nothing here is a measurement; measurements live in manifests and
run outputs. Each entry records where it was read and when.

gdn_batch_invariant.title: Batch invariance not supported for GDN_ATTN
gdn_batch_invariant.why_it_matters: vLLM raises RuntimeError when VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 is set on a Gated DeltaNet attention model, so byte-reproducible greedy decoding is unavailable on Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6 class architectures

fused_moe_batch_invariant.title: Batch invariance not supported for fused MoE
fused_moe_batch_invariant.why_it_matters: the same flag is refused for fused mixture-of-experts kernels, which rules out the MoE variants of several current candidates

model.note: release date of the Qwen2.5 instruct series as published on the model card; the training data cutoff is not documented by the publisher

p2_1.reason: P2.1 recalibration was requested and has not run. The dataset specification states the threshold and the defect in its evidence plainly rather than waiting.

seed2.note: second-seed replication of Cond-1 and Cond-2 was launched on the DGX and had not finished when these documents were built; the findings state the single-seed limitation in the finding itself

interpretation_rule._comment: Fixed and committed while seed 5678 was still training, before any of its scores existed. Deciding what agreement means after seeing the numbers is not interpretation, it is selection.
interpretation_rule.agreement: For each general benchmark, the seed-5678 run agrees with seed-1234 when the Cond-1 vs Cond-2 paired difference carries the same sign AND the same Holm-adjusted verdict.
interpretation_rule.if_both_agree: the finding stands on two independent draws and the single-seed caveat is replaced by what the two seeds showed.
interpretation_rule.if_either_disagrees: the design does not separate a replay effect from seed variance, and that is the conclusion to publish -- not the seed that happened to agree.
interpretation_rule.also_measured: cond1(1234) vs cond1(5678) and cond2(1234) vs cond2(5678), paired over the same evaluation items, so seed-to-seed movement is measured directly instead of inferred from two separate comparisons.
interpretation_rule.limit: two seeds give one seed-to-seed difference per condition, not a variance estimate. A difference smaller than the paired MDD is not evidence of stability.
interpretation_rule._translation_note: Korean renderings added after the run finished, for the Korean documents. The English fields are the committed pre-registration (commit b32688c) and are byte-unchanged; the diff shows only additions.
interpretation_rule.agreement_ko: 벤치마크별로, 시드 5678의 Cond-1 vs Cond-2 쌍 차이가 시드 1234와 부호가 같고 Holm 보정 판정도 같을 때 일치로 본다.
interpretation_rule.if_both_agree_ko: 결론은 독립적인 두 번의 추출 위에 서고, 단일 시드 단서는 두 시드가 보여준 것으로 대체된다.
interpretation_rule.if_either_disagrees_ko: 이 설계는 리플레이 효과와 시드 분산을 분리하지 못하며, 일치한 쪽이 아니라 그 사실이 결론이 된다.
interpretation_rule.limit_ko: 시드 두 개는 조건당 차이 한 번을 줄 뿐 분산을 추정하지 못한다. 짝지은 MDD보다 작은 차이는 안정성의 증거가 아니다.
